description: The secret files of the OPT-IN read-only BI port (compose.bi.yaml, install.sh --with-bi): names, readers, rotation, ownership. Same rules as secrets.json (references only, a value here fails infra:check, files root:MACHVON_SECRETS_GID mode 0440); install.sh requires these files only when the BI port is switched on. The BI logins themselves are not files: INT-04 makes them and shows the password once.

secrets.name: db_tls_cert
secrets.purpose: Server certificate chain (PEM) of the BI port of the database, issued by the certificate authority the BI tools trust (the name or address the tools connect to must be in it)
secrets.generate: issued by the certificate authority of the customer (PX-11); leaf first, then the intermediates

secrets.name: db_tls_key
secrets.purpose: Private key (PEM) of the server certificate of the BI port of the database
secrets.generate: openssl genpkey -algorithm EC -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 (then a certificate request to the certificate authority of the customer)
